messages.subject: BINARY TRAIT
parts:
question :
 i have a binary trait i didnt use the command from the R\qtl instead for each marker i used 
a log likelihood ratio test between the null model and the model that contains the genotype
it means that the score was calculated by the diffrence beteen the models deviance
?should i need to divide the results by  2LOG10 in this case in order to get the results in a lod score scale

thank you 

elad

messages.author: 96353e7106735838
messages.subject: Re: [Rqtl-disc] BINARY TRAIT
parts:
Yes the usual likelihood ratio test statistic would be 2 ln (LR).
To convert that to LOD scale, or log_10(LR), you’d divide by 2 ln(10)

karl
